content: SSO/OAuth-style flows are commonly broken by: (1) open redirect via unvalidated redirect_uri -- mitigated by exact-match allowlisting, not prefix/substring matching; (2) missing or reused state/anti-CSRF parameter -- must be single-use, invalidated immediately after the callback is consumed; (3) token replay -- servers that don't check expiry/nonce/one-time-use accept previously captured tokens again. All three apply directly to a custom redirect+server-verify handshake, not just standard OAuth.
